categories.name: جَمَاعَاتٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ
categories.nameEn: Groups of people mentioned in the Qur'an

items.verse: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
items.verseEn: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators

categories.name: أَفْعَالُ الْقَوْلِ وَالسُّؤَالِ
categories.nameEn: Verbs of speech and questioning in the Qur'an

items.verse: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
items.verseEn: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.
Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,
So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?

categories.name: الكُفْرُ وَالتَّكْذِيبُ وَالفِتْنَةُ
categories.nameEn: Acts and agents of disbelief and misguidance

items.verseEn: The people of Lot denied the messengers
But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.

categories.name: صِيَغُ جَمْعِ الْمُذَكَّرِ السَّالِمِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Words with masculine plural endings (-ūn/-īn) in the Qur'an

items.verse: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
items.verseEn: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
Then will you not be reminded?
And your movement among those who prostrate.
